title: Airy Light Turkish Iceberg Lettuce Cig Kofte
description: A plant-based Turkish dish featuring marinated iceberg lettuce, this recipe is a unique and refreshing twist on traditional cig kofte. It is cultured, dense, and light, making it perfect for a snack or lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped iceberg lettuce, diced red bell pepper, and finely chopped onion.
In a separate bowl, mix together bulgur, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the bulgur mixture to the lettuce mixture and stir until well combined.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice over the mixture and toss to coat.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small cylindrical shapes, similar to cig kofte.
Place the shaped mixture on a serving plate or tray.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional lettuce leaves if desired.
